newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones down by 13.04 points to 5,966.77. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 1 1/8 to $60 1/8.
* The peso closed steady at 26.269 to a U.S.dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,037.54, down 83.49.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate up to 12.75 percent from 12.5625.
* Brokerage Philippine Asia Equity Securities Inc said Tuesday's fall was caused by foreign funds which continued to reduce their weightings on Asian markets.

"It seems that the bearish sentiment on the top-end property market is causing a drag on the index as a whole forcing some revaluation on other issues. We do expect some bargain hunting to come in soon after a lot of stocks falls to levels of incredibly good value," Philippine Asia Equity said.
* Brokerage Sun Hung Kai Securities said the market still remained bearish as the index leans towards another slump to hit the next support level at 2,980.

It said market value turnover would keep steady above the 2.0 billion (peso) mark as investors make attempts to position themselves into potentially lucrative sectors other than property. "We may also see some play on second and third liners that pose better bargains than most blue chips," Sun Hung Kai said.
